summary: This background figure (§2, Understanding EBOF) documents the Fungible FS1600, the commodity EBOF chassis the paper's elastic block storage system is built over. Panel (a) labels a cluster setup with Composer Nodes and Compute Nodes around an FS1600 and its Ethernet Switch, though the panel's own diagram did not render in this extraction, leaving only yellow annotation callouts. Panels (b) and (c) are photos of the chassis's front panel (24 NVMe drive bays) and back panel (12 100GbE port cabling). Panel (d) details the internal architecture: an Internal Ethernet Switch with 12 ports fans network traffic out to two identical I/O Processing Pipelines, each chaining NVMe-oF Cores, I/O Accelerators (compression, encryption, erasure coding), and I/O Orchestration (a Traffic Manager plus per-SSD submission/completion queues) before reaching 12 NVMe SSDs per pipeline.
summary_zh: 该图展示Fungible FS1600 EBOF硬件：(a)机柜标注（图未渲染），(b)(c)为前后面板照片，(d)展示内部架构——交换机将流量分发给两条并行I/O流水线，各接12块NVMe SSD。
notes: Panel (a)'s own cluster-setup image did not render in this PDF-extracted SVG (only yellow annotation text/brackets are present over blank space); and the given text is truncated exactly where it would explain the pipeline stages' internals ('packets undergo a sequence of processing stages along the pipeline:'), so several component roles in panel (d) are read from figure labels only. layout-proposal: photo-plus-pipeline-grid — a 2x2 grid mixing a (largely missing) cluster-setup diagram with two hardware photos and one internal two-lane pipeline architecture diagram (switch to NVMe-oF Cores to I/O Accelerators to I/O Orchestration to SSDs).
